modes.local_only: Use only saved evidence, verified claims, graph relationships, and metric snapshots. Never call an external API.
modes.local_first: Inspect local evidence first. Trigger fresh research only when verified coverage is insufficient or relevant evidence is older than the configured threshold.
modes.live_refresh: Inspect local evidence first, then always perform bounded fresh web and builder research before synthesis.

external_research.note: SEC EDGAR retrieval is CIK-targeted and is not automatically run for an unclassified idea.

evidence_boundary.facts: Only source-backed evidence records and verified/manual-confirmed claims may be presented as facts or used in calculations.
evidence_boundary.new_external_results: Freshly retrieved results are labelled unverified until a reviewer confirms their claims.
evidence_boundary.model_knowledge: The LLM may reason over retrieved context but its unstated background knowledge is never presented as Idea Casino evidence.
evidence_boundary.calculations: Metric values are produced by the deterministic calculation engine, not the LLM.
